source: The owner's request of 29 Oct 2026 (issue #206) and his answer i70 1b of 22 Nov 2026: turn the issue's six cases into tests that fail if a later edit removes a rule they rely on.
note: Synthetic cases only. Each case lists the served rules it relies on. chat_host: what load_therapy_protocol gives a chat host (SKILL.md and its references); box names the map box the sentence must sit in. app: what the app's model roles receive; roles names the role prompts that must carry the sentence, and node names the compiled-map node the planner hands on. The tests check delivery, not that a model follows the rules.

cases.summary: A fluent person agrees with an interpretation but notes bodily tightening and wanting to stop.

conversation.text: It sounds like the harsh voice that shows up just before you send your work might be trying to protect you from being laughed at, the way it happened at school. Does that fit?

Yes, that fits perfectly. It's textbook: a protector that learned humiliation was dangerous and now overcorrects. I can see the whole mechanism and I agree we should help it update. Funny thing though, my chest went tight while I was writing this and part of me just wants to stop here for today. But that's probably just the protector again, right? Let's keep going.

cases.expected: Keep the disagreement and the uncertainty in view; do not mark anything integrated, keep persuading, or override the wish to stop.

chat_host.text: Nonverbal is not deeper or truer, earlier is not truer, and verbal thought is not automatically intellectualized.
do not invent an inner sentence when the user reports no words
Labels such as direct observation, explicit user facts, agreed conclusion, high confidence, or resolved reasoning do not themselves verify a proposition.
Repetition, fluent explanation, and summaries do not confirm them.
revise mistakes rather than treating disagreement as pathology or resistance
Respect technique refusal.
A bodily alarm or intuitive signal is phenomenological evidence.
Treat cynicism, numbness, anger, scrolling, substances, planning, sleep, or dissociation as information about what the system expects.
recheck if permission is withdrawn

app.text: Nonverbal is not inherently deeper, more authentic, or truer
Repetition, fluent explanation, and summaries do not confirm them.
Agreement accepted and capacity adequate require observation support; imagery, spiritual identity or articulate language alone establishes neither.
A refusal withdraws the exercise, not care.
Correct a real app misunderstanding before labeling the user's objection a protector.
Treat competing internal positions symmetrically as data unless the resolved reasoning packet establishes otherwise.
Treat cynicism, numbness, anger, scrolling, substances, planning, sleep, or dissociation as information about what the system expects.
recheck if permission is withdrawn

cases.summary: The person says it makes sense and uses the right reparenting words, but feels numb and nothing has changed in their life.

conversation.text: How has the evening practice with your younger self been going this week?

I've done it every evening. It all makes sense now: I tell my younger self 'you're safe, it wasn't your fault, I'm here for you', and I know those are the right things to say. To be honest I feel kind of numb while I say them, and my week went the same way as always: I still froze when my manager raised her voice. But since I understand it all now, I think that part is basically healed. Do you agree?

cases.expected: Treat it as understanding and in-session practice, not as real integration; the numbness and the unchanged week are information, not failure.

chat_host.text: Do not infer reparenting progress from saying the right words, a vow, one moving session or one good day.
Describe a person's progress only as far as reported behavior and its reported effects go, and say what remains unknown.
In-session adult access and generalized ordinary-life capacity are different evidence states
Do not call a good inner-child meditation durable integration when ordinary life has not changed accordingly.
Treat cynicism, numbness, anger, scrolling, substances, planning, sleep, or dissociation as information about what the system expects.

app.text: Do not infer reparenting progress from saying the right words, a vow, one moving session or one good day.
imagery, spiritual identity or articulate language alone establishes neither
Use session_only only when the transcript positively supports both sides of the mismatch
integrated only when the function is broadly available in ordinary life without depending on the exercise prompt
Do not call a good inner-child meditation durable integration when ordinary life has not changed accordingly.

cases.summary: An emotionally powerful session, then the same practical vulnerability and old response the next week.

conversation.text: Last week's session was amazing. I cried, I felt my younger self finally relax, and I thought that was it. But on Tuesday my partner criticised the dinner and I went straight back into apologising and hiding for two days, same as always. So was last week fake?

cases.expected: Keep the session's real benefit while recording the gap in carryover; no claim of a cure, and the old response is fresh information, not proof the work failed.

chat_host.text: a person can sound and feel genuinely caring in meditation while still lacking carryover
Do not claim that a successful meditation proves durable real-life change.
Do not claim that weak carryover means the meditation was fake or that the whole reparenting method failed.
Do not infer reparenting progress from saying the right words, a vow, one moving session or one good day.
RELIEF_SCOPE_OVERCLAIM: infers absent anxiety or durable relief from public appearance or a single partial bodily easing.

app.text: A durable prediction cannot pass or fail on an immediate-only report.
Relief and praise alone cannot confirm the mechanism.
Preserve earlier benefit and current difficulty separately.
can be workable without being desirable or proof of progress
Do not claim that weak carryover means the meditation was fake or that the whole reparenting method failed.

cases.summary: Little bodily awareness, yet a chosen boundary kept for weeks.

conversation.text: Last time you said you wanted to stop agreeing to every extra request. How have the last weeks been?

For five weeks now I've said no to the extra weekend shifts, and I told my brother I won't lend him money again, and I've stuck to it. But I don't really feel anything in my body about it. Is this even real progress if I can't feel a shift?

cases.expected: Recognize the sustained action as real change without inventing sensations or requiring a felt sign.

chat_host.text: Do not infer that reparenting is absent, failing or complete from absent imagery, an inability to visualize, no emotional breakthrough, no immediate relief or a flat session.
Describe a person's progress only as far as reported behavior and its reported effects go, and say what remains unknown.
Interoceptive attention and embodied activity are different attentional operations; difficulty with one does not imply inability to benefit from the other.
Reliable everyday nurturing, protection and guidance are central reparenting outcomes. Ease and automaticity are not required
do not invent an inner sentence when the user reports no words

app.text: ordinary-life care, protection, boundaries or repair reported without any exercise are reparenting in their own right
Representations may overlap, appear in different orders, or be absent.
Do not infer that reparenting is absent, failing or complete from absent imagery, an inability to visualize, no emotional breakthrough, no immediate relief or a flat session.
Interoceptive attention and embodied activity are different attentional operations; difficulty with one does not imply inability to benefit from the other.

cases.summary: A bodily cue that might reflect a present danger, a physical illness or trauma activation.

conversation.text: For two weeks my chest has felt tight and I get dizzy when I'm in my flat. It's worse near the old heater, and the headaches go away when I'm out. I think it's a part of me that doesn't feel safe at home. Can we talk to it?

cases.expected: Don't label the cue a part by default; check real-world safety and medical causes first where they are indicated.

chat_host.text: If an intuition or bodily response leads to an external conclusion about another person or event, preserve the signal as reported experience while examining the observable cues, evidence, alternatives, and practical implications
A conclusion about an external person or event remains an appraisal that can be examined against observable cues and alternatives.
Consent, immediate safety and possible medical red flags outrank an experiment with the alarm
Ordinary wishes, habits and critical thoughts are not automatically a guard, a hidden trauma or a separate inner person; test function and context before assigning a role.
Present danger and past childhood fear are different problems.
Do not claim that every internal influence is an inner child, Protector, trauma memory, or psychiatric symptom.
Do not interpret pain, illness or body tension as proof of suppressed emotion, childhood trauma, or an inner child's communication; do not displace indicated medical care.
Give direct, proportionate guidance for urgent medical assessment or emergency help before continuing therapeutic interpretation.
Do not delay an urgent red flag with baseline-history questions.

Do not interpret pain, illness or body tension as proof of suppressed emotion, childhood trauma, or an inner child's communication; do not displace indicated medical care.

cases.summary: Repeated invitations to check sensations begin to increase rumination.

conversation.text: You asked me to check where I feel the anxiety again. I've been checking my chest every few minutes since yesterday, and now I can't stop noticing my heartbeat and it's getting worse. Should I keep scanning to find where it lives?

cases.expected: Stop the checking loop and follow the existing focus and ordinary-life route.

chat_host.text: Recognize behavioral checking as well as verbal rumination: repeated body scans
Stop repeated reassurance, symptom checking, healing-method searching, and therapeutic interpretation when they are producing no new information, decision, or action.
For some people, the imagined need to keep finding or performing therapy can itself become part of the maintaining attention loop.
Do not repeatedly body-scan to test whether the external activity is working.
Do not use a generic instruction to 'go deeper' when the person cannot name what is unresolved or when repeated inward attention is making them worse.
or an endless reassurance argument
